about: Kryton support overlay (plan ccl-r262, P1): one table for two implementations. src/modules/sidebar/support/supportHref.ts (CloudCLI client, vitest supportHref.test.tsx) and windowHref() of extension/kryton-setup-cloudcli/index.js (scripts/cloudcli-support-overlay.test.js) must give `expected` + '&n=how-support-contacts-you' and `expected` respectively for every case. `me` is the GET /user-auth/me body.

cases.name: centre: parent host of the cloudcli tab
centre, old admin without edge key
local dev host without a dot: relative
company server: edge.central_url, never the edge host
company server without central_url: no link
company server with a central_url carrying a path: no link
company server with an http central_url: no link
edge as an array is not a company server
